data.rationale: HDFC Bank maintains industry-leading metrics post-merger integration. Loan growth of 14% initially reflects HDFC Ltd merger stabilization and strong retail franchise, moderating to 12% as base enlarges. NIM sustains at 4.0%+ (among highest in sector) due to superior CASA franchise improving from 43% to 47%, benefiting from cross-sell opportunities. Credit costs remain benign at sub-1% reflecting best-in-class underwriting. Cost-to-income improves from 42% to 38% as merger synergies materialize and operating leverage kicks in. ROA of 2%+ and ROE improving from 16.5% to 18.5% reflect scale advantages, operational efficiency, and superior asset quality. Assumptions factor in India's 6-7% GDP growth, stable rate environment, and HDFC Bank's track record of consistent performance and market share gains in retail lending.
